# Anythink

> Whatever you're building, Anythink handles the backend
Anythink is a backend as a service.
We build the Auth, Payment, Storage, Search, Workflow and DB for your app so you can focus on your core product.
Replace Supabase, Airtable, n8n, Zapier, Directus and Firebase. Build 40x faster, with or without AI. From prototype to production easily. Visual database design, auto-generated APIs, built-in workflows, and enterprise security.
Anythink is the operating system for AI-powered development. Whether you're building with Cursor, Claude, v0, or other AI coding assistants, Anythink provides enterprise-grade backend infrastructure that scales from prototype to millions of users. Transform your concept into a complete platform with visual database design, auto-generated APIs, workflow automation, payments, and user management - all managed through one intuitive dashboard.

**Key Capabilities:**
- Visual Database Designer: Point, click, build your database with advanced field types and complex relationships
- Instant APIs: Every entity becomes a fully-featured REST API with comprehensive documentation and filtering
- Multi-Tenant Architecture: Built-in tenant isolation with granular permissions and customizable dashboards
- Smart File Manager: Global CDN distribution with automatic optimization and secure access controls
- Powerful Search Engine: Lightning-fast full-text search with intelligent filters and real-time indexing
- Workflow Automation: Visual workflow builder with advanced logic and API integrations
- Payment Engine: Enterprise payment processing with marketplace support and subscription management
- Enterprise Security: Advanced authentication, role-based access control, and compliance-ready infrastructure

**AI Integration:** Purpose-built for AI development workflows with seamless integration capabilities for AI coding assistants and automated development processes.

## Product Categories

- [Visual Database Designer](https://anythink.cloud/products/visual_database_designer): Point, click, build your database with visual tools
- [Instant APIs](https://anythink.cloud/products/instant_apis): APIs that build themselves with zero configuration
- [Authentication](https://anythink.cloud/products/authentication): User management deeply integrated into your applications
- [Smart File Manager](https://anythink.cloud/products/smart_file_manager): Save, store, serve files anywhere with CDN distribution
- [Workflow Automation](https://anythink.cloud/products/workflow_automation): Automate everything that matters with visual workflows
- [Payment Engine](https://anythink.cloud/products/payment_engine): Stripe-powered payments without the setup hassle
- [Powerful Search Engine](https://anythink.cloud/products/powerful-search-engine): Find anything instantly across all your data
- [Access Control](https://anythink.cloud/products/access_control): Control who sees what, precisely
